-NOTE-
This game is in Alpha, so expect bugs and glitches! If you encounter any problems, feel free to tell us on the group's wall.

🎮CONTROLS - PC/Mobile🎮
Movement - WASD/Joystick
Interact - E/Click/Tap
Sprint - LShift/HoldSprintBtn
AimAssist - T/TapBtn

-STORY-
Welcome to Dinosaur Island : Lab Breakout. A STORY game set in a laboratory on one of Canada's islands. The once-secure Lab has been breached, and the deadly DINOSAURS have broken free from their enclosures. As the chaos happens, the army is deployed to regain control. Experience the story from two perspectives: Alex, a Velociraptor researcher, and Roger, a US Marine. It's YOUR job to figure out what happened and how to survive inside the laboratory to escape!
